profile.name: Next Bar operator
profile.goal: Learn to design and run evidence-backed growth experiments for one dense nightlife market

nodes.name: One avatar and one offer
nodes.mastery_test: Define one organizer, one moment of pain, one promised outcome, and one activation event without notes, then earn a clear preference from at least three intended users
nodes.proof: Dated avatar-offer test table with exact user responses

nodes.name: Concierge customer learning
nodes.mastery_test: Deliver ten manual group plans and accurately classify the recurring objections and decision moments

nodes.name: Proof-led content
nodes.mastery_test: Create three proof-promise-plan cases for the same organizer and identify which produces the most qualified planner starts
nodes.proof: Three source-linked cases plus qualified-action comparison

nodes.name: Measured distribution
nodes.mastery_test: Run one bounded channel experiment and diagnose its largest drop-off from reach through activation

nodes.name: Referral and repeat loop
nodes.mastery_test: Show that at least one organizer creates a recipient vote and later activates again, then explain the causal uncertainty
nodes.proof: Share-to-vote receipt and delayed repeat-use receipt
